CVE-2026-85091 is a heap buffer overflow in zlib's gz_vacate(), reached only by calling gzprintf() or gzvprintf() on a gzFile after a stalled non-blocking gzwrite(). No binary in the DockVault image imports gzprintf, gzvprintf, gzputs or gzwrite -- zlib's consumers there, Python's zlib module and apk, use the deflate/inflate stream API -- and no Python code loads zlib through ctypes, so zlib's gz write path is never executed. Verified for source revision __SOURCE_REVISION__.
